stem: In the story “Peace and Quiet,” why is it important to the plot that James knows about the clearing in the forest?

options.label: F
options.text: His knowledge reminds him of a place he can go when he needs help from a family member.

options.label: G
options.text: His knowledge helps him recognize how quickly his sister is growing up.

options.label: H
options.text: His knowledge makes it possible for him to find Desha and talk to her.

options.label: J
options.text: His knowledge leads him to a place that reminds him of Daniel.
